text.en: Recent reviews praise the styling and trimming quality across different breeds, including German Shepherds and anxious chow chows. Clients report their dogs returning cleanly styled and smelling lovely, with several pet parents immediately booking their next appointments.

Reviewers consistently highlight the friendly, welcoming, and reassuring approach of groomers and trainers like Molly, Steph, and Katie. Trainees and grooming clients alike note that staff take time to explain processes, maintain high standards, and put everyone at ease.

Pet owners note that groomers demonstrate great patience and gentle care, successfully comforting nervous or apprehensive dogs. Clients highlight calm introductions, careful face and paw trimming, and a stress-free environment that builds trust with pets over time.

q.en: Can groomers accommodate nervous or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report that groomers take time to comfort anxious pets and handle sensitive tasks like blow drying and paw clipping calmly.

q.en: Are grooming academy courses offered at this salon?

a.en: Yes, reviewers include trainees who completed accredited grooming qualifications with warm support from the academy instructors.

q.en: How do clients rate the grooming results?

a.en: Clients consistently report neat, breed-appropriate haircuts and leave positive feedback regarding coat styling and cleanliness.
